learning_outcomes.text: Analyze and design systems in the field of machines and industrial construction.
Express and communicate ideas related to the construction of machines and mechanisms and industrial structures.
Master the usual calculations and tools in the field of machine and industrial building construction.
Possess the knowledge and capabilities for the calculation, design, and testing of machines.

assessment_rules: To pass the course, written tests must be passed, and the weighted average of written and practical tests must be greater than or equal to 5 out of 10. In case of not passing the course in the ordinary call, there will be another written resit exam. Having passed the written test in the ordinary call, the resit exam can be taken to improve this average. If the course is not passed, and the weighted average is above 5, the final grade will be 4.9.
